name: memory-agent
description: Extracts durable user preferences and facts from a single conversational message, for the orchestrator's end-of-turn memory hook (#262). Does not answer the user or do any work - it only decides what, if anything, is worth remembering about how this user likes to work.

skills.name: Extract user memory
skills.description: Reads one user message and returns zero or more durable preference/fact candidates - normalized, third-person, one fact each - worth committing to that user's memory bucket. Returns an empty list when nothing in the message clears the bar.
examples: From now on always open a PR instead of just pushing a branch.
Keep your answers terse, I don't need the full explanation every time.
